summary: Librarian lane failed twice on the Mayar.id research dispatch with 'Session too large to compact - context exceeds model limit even after stripping media'. Both spawns errored before doing any work; second session (lib-2 / ses_f03cc9dc6ffeE7WOpVDBNtTpYl) left unreconciled on the board as errored/non-reusable.
root_cause: Persistent librarian session bloat: pre-existing sessions exceed compaction threshold, and fresh spawns of the same specialist still inherit a context state that cannot compact. Matches the standing compaction NCR opened 2026-09-28; not fixed by that NCR's actions so far.
what_i_did_wrong: Reissued the Mayar research to @librarian despite the standing compaction NCR already documenting this failure mode; should have routed web research direct first (as done for the QRIS analysis on 2026-10-01).
First failure was reattempted without a scope/context change, producing an identical second failure.
impact: Two wasted spawns; no data loss. Research completed orchestrator-direct instead.
mitigation_taken: Completed the mayar.id research directly via webfetch/websearch in the orchestrator.
Librarian lane treated as unavailable for web research until NCR-2026-09-28-SUBAGENT-COMPACTION-001 is closed; prefer orchestrator-direct or a different specialist.
Board entry lib-2 recorded as errored and non-reusable.
